name: ecoquiz
description: ECOQUIZ - plataforma gamificada de educação ambiental.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c "#2F8054,#2563EB" "npm run dev --workspace @ecoquiz/server" "npm run dev --workspace @ecoquiz/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ecoquiz/shared && npm run build --workspace @ecoquiz/server && npm run build --workspace @ecoquiz/web
scripts.build:pnpm: pnpm --filter @ecoquiz/shared build && pnpm --filter @ecoquiz/server build && pnpm --filter @ecoquiz/web build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @ecoquiz/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @ecoquiz/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @ecoquiz/web
scripts.typecheck:pnpm: pnpm --filter @ecoquiz/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @ecoquiz/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @ecoquiz/web typecheck
